draft.title: Reducing climate change
card: Climate change is driven by greenhouse gases added to the air by human activity. Reducing it means cutting these emissions and keeping carbon out of the air.
Burning coal, oil and gas for electricity releases carbon dioxide. Wind, solar and hydro power release far less when they run, so using more of them cuts emissions.
Farms can cut methane from livestock and waste. Buildings can use less energy, factories can use cleaner energy, and travel can shift to electric vehicles, trains and bikes.
Trees take in carbon dioxide as they grow. Keeping forests standing stops stored carbon being released, and planting new trees can take more carbon from the air.
draft.remember: Cut emissions from power, farming, building, goods and travel, and keep forests standing.

a.q: A town replaces its coal-fired power station with a wind farm. How does this help reduce climate change?
opts: It releases much less carbon dioxide to make electricity
It makes trees absorb more carbon dioxide from the air
It removes methane from the air by farming less land
It stops the Sun from warming Earth's surface
a.why: Coal burning releases carbon dioxide, and a wind farm releases far less when it runs, so emissions fall. Planting trees is a different action and the wind farm does not make trees absorb more.
a.clue: Think about what is released when the fuel is burnt.

b.q: A council wants to cut emissions and has land covered in mature forest. Which plan best reduces climate change?
opts: Keep the forest and run its buses on electricity
Clear the forest and build a solar farm in its place
Clear the forest and plant crops that grow quickly
Keep the forest and burn more gas for council heating
b.why: The standing forest keeps its stored carbon out of the air, and electric buses can cut emissions from travel. Clearing the forest for a solar farm cuts power emissions but releases the carbon the trees hold, so it is a tempting but weaker plan.
b.clue: Check that each part of the plan lowers emissions or keeps carbon stored.

a.best: It releases much less carbon dioxide to make electricity

b.best: Keep the forest and run its buses on electricity
